title: feat: add interactive route summary card

issue.title: TASK-b4e2 feat: add interactive route summary card

description:
## Goal
Make key route information easier to understand and keep it synchronized with route edits.

## Requirements
- Add a compact route summary card with distance and estimated travel time.
- Show elevation gain/loss when available.
- Show the number of route points.
- Show route difficulty only when a defined calculation is available.
- Use compact visual indicators.
- Highlight the relevant route segment when a metric supports segment-level interaction.
- Adapt the card for mobile layouts.
- Update values after route creation and after point moves/edits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Card displays current route metrics after route creation.
- [ ] Metrics update after route points are added, removed, or dragged.
- [ ] Unavailable metrics are omitted or shown in a neutral state.
- [ ] Card remains readable and does not block important map interactions.
- [ ] Mobile presentation is compact and usable.
- [ ] Existing route editing behavior is preserved.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Metric calculation/reuse follows existing project architecture.
- [ ] Relevant tests are added or updated.
- [ ] Existing test suite passes.
- [ ] No regression in route rendering or editing.
